facts.fact: The National Population Commission's own news item names Barnksforte Technologies Limited as 'the technical partner to the National Population Commission' for the Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (e-CRVS) system, whose managing director spoke on its digitisation; no date is given beyond the item's own, so the published date is used.
